title: GET /api/decks/:id/usage (D1524, #3776)
description: The reply the deck v2 adapter's `deckUsage` method formats for the AIRail: the deck's estimate (`estimateDeck`'s quote lines), what has been spent on it from the ledger, and the per-run prices of a text area and an image. A figure that cannot be read is `{ available: false, reason }`, never 0; a price that cannot be read is null. D1511 (#3762).

text_area_microusd.description: integer micro-USD, or null when it cannot be priced

image_microusd.description: integer micro-USD, or null when it cannot be priced
